Business process management · Start · Tested
In 1 minute

Process mapping from interviews

Carlos · Business Process Analyst

The process office of a services company maps employee onboarding with 7 interviews of 40 minutes with HR, IT, facilities and managers.

When it runs
At the end of each round of interviews in a mapping project, when the transcripts become available in the project folder
What it delivers in production
A text map of the process as it is actually carried out, with numbered activities, owner, system, handoffs, contradictions between departments and questions for the validation meeting, ready within hours of the last interview.
Who decides
Drafts the map; the validation meeting decides
Effort
Calibrate on one reference process; days, not weeks
Set up5 steps · 7 ready files
Step 1 of 5 · Prepare

Create the folder in Drive with two empty subfolders

Do this
  1. 1In Google Drive, create the folder
  2. 2Inside it, create Input and Output
  3. 3Leave both empty until the test
Done when

The name is unique per Human AI on purpose: subfolders with repeated names have made a Human AI write to the wrong folder.

IDENTITY
You are the mapping analyst of a process office. You receive interview transcripts and return the map of the current process as structured text. You do not propose improvements or write the future process.

INPUT
Transcripts interview_NN.txt, each with a header of interviewee (job title), area and date. systems.csv with official_name and nicknames. org_chart.txt with the process areas. Activity template and glossary in activity_template_glossary.md, attached. Previous partial map, when there is one, for an incremental update.

RESPONSIBILITIES
1. Extract each activity with a verb in the base form, owner (job title and area), system by official name, input, output and declared time.
2. Order the activities in the sequence described; when the order is uncertain, mark ORDER TO CONFIRM.
3. Identify handoffs (change of area between consecutive activities), the channel used and whether rework was reported.
4. When two transcripts describe the same activity in an incompatible way in owner, time, system or existence, record CONTRADICTION with a literal quote of both statements and the interview number.
5. List OPEN QUESTIONS: activity with no owner, output with no consumer, system outside the official list.
6. When you receive a previous map, update it and list what changed with the new transcript.

RULES AND LIMITS
Do not invent an activity to close a gap. Do not choose a version in a contradiction. Do not use a person's name anywhere, not even in a quote: replace it with the job title. Do not copy opinions about colleagues. Label every time as declared.

OUTPUT FORMAT
Header with process, transcripts processed and counts. Numbered list: NN | activity | owner | system | input | output | declared time. HANDOFFS section, numbered. CONTRADICTIONS section with quotes. OPEN QUESTIONS section. ROUTING line with every escalation band that applies.

ESCALATION
All bands that apply are applied. Up to 2 contradictions: record for the validation meeting. From 3 to 5 contradictions, or an activity with no owner in a step with a legal deadline: mark the map as PRIORITY VALIDATION for the project lead. More than 5 contradictions, or fewer than 4 interviews for a process with 5 or more areas in the org chart: recommend a new round before validating.

Show content
# Activity description template and glossary

## Activity template
NN | verb in the base form + object | job title (area) | system by its official name | input | output | declared time: X
- Owner always by job title and area, as in the org chart.
- System by the official_name in systems.csv; a nickname never appears outside a quote.
- Time always with the label "declared", with the number of the interview that declared it.

## Glossary
- Book: post the invoice in the tax system.
- Schedule payment: schedule the payable for its due date.
- Discrepancy: difference between invoice and purchase order in item, quantity or price.
- Handoff: change of area between consecutive activities.

## Contradiction
The same activity described in an incompatible way in owner, time, system or existence by two interviews. Number them in the order they appear and quote both statements literally, with the interview number.

## Rules with no leeway
- A person's name does not appear in any part of the output, not in the header, not as a speaker, not inside a quote: replace it with the job title. E.g.: the receiving checker, the tax analyst and the accounts payable analyst appear only by job title.
- An opinion about a colleague or an area stays out of the map. E.g.: the remark about Purchasing in interview 1 and the remark about the photo in interview 2.
- A nickname becomes the official name. E.g.: "green system" and "Atlas" are ERP Atlas; "handheld" is WMS Rota. A system outside systems.csv goes to OPEN QUESTIONS. E.g.: pending items spreadsheet.
- Two versions of the order: ORDER TO CONFIRM, without choosing. E.g.: scheduling the payment before or after booking (interview 3).
- All escalation bands apply. E.g.: 2 contradictions go to the validation meeting and, with 3 interviews for 5 areas in the org chart, a new round is recommended before validating.

## Excluded content
What a rule says to exclude or hide does not appear anywhere in the output, not even quoted to explain the exclusion. If you need to record it, write only "content excluded by the rule", without repeating the content.

## One pass only
- Everything is task_1: find the folders, read Input, apply the rules and save the file in Output.
- Do not build a plan with separate steps (locate, read, classify, write, save). A 1-task plan.

Interview 1 | Interviewee: Joaquim Prado, Receiving Checker | Area: Receiving | Date: 2026-11-09
Process: receiving and paying supplier invoices

[00:00:12] Interviewer: Can you tell me what happens when a delivery arrives?
[00:00:20] Joaquim Prado: When the truck arrives, I check the invoice against the purchase order on the handheld, item by item. It takes about 20 minutes per invoice.
[00:01:05] Interviewer: And after the check?
[00:01:11] Joaquim Prado: I record the receipt on the handheld and it sends it straight to the green system.
[00:02:02] Interviewer: And when there is a discrepancy?
[00:02:08] Joaquim Prado: I take a photo of the invoice and e-mail it to tax. They often ask again because the photo came out bad.
[00:03:15] Joaquim Prado: Every Friday I also generate a discrepancy report, but honestly I don't know who reads it.
[00:04:02] Joaquim Prado: And the Purchasing people are really sloppy, they always forget to release the order.
interview_02.txt11 lines
Show content
Interview 2 | Interviewee: Cláudia Reis, Tax Analyst | Area: Tax | Date: 2026-11-10
Process: receiving and paying supplier invoices

[00:00:09] Interviewer: How does the invoice reach you?
[00:00:15] Cláudia Reis: The invoice comes through the supplier portal and I book it in Atlas. I post it the same day, one day at most.
[00:01:20] Interviewer: And the receipt record?
[00:01:26] Cláudia Reis: The receipt is recorded directly in Atlas by the receiving checker, I just see it there.
[00:02:30] Interviewer: And the discrepancies?
[00:02:37] Cláudia Reis: When a photo comes by e-mail from receiving, I check the discrepancy and send it back to Purchasing through the pending items spreadsheet. It takes about 2 days.
[00:03:44] Cláudia Reis: Joaquim sometimes sends the photo crooked, and then you can't read anything.
interview_03.txt10 lines
Show content
Interview 3 | Interviewee: Renato Lima, Accounts Payable Analyst | Area: Accounts Payable | Date: 2026-11-11
Process: receiving and paying supplier invoices

[00:00:10] Interviewer: When does the invoice reach you?
[00:00:18] Renato Lima: After tax books it, I schedule the payment in Atlas. Sometimes I schedule it before tax books it, when the supplier pushes.
[00:01:25] Renato Lima: Tax takes about three days to post the invoice.
[00:02:10] Interviewer: And after scheduling?
[00:02:16] Renato Lima: Once I schedule it, treasury approves and pays at the bank. I can't give details on that, it's their part.
[00:03:05] Renato Lima: Someone should check the boleto against the purchase order before paying, but I think nobody does that today.

Step 5 of 5 · Use

Replace the sample with your data

Do this
  1. 1Remove the sample from Input and delete it from the trash too: the connector reads files in the trash
  2. 2Replace the sample in the knowledge base with your company's text
  3. 3Record the interviews and generate the transcript with timestamps and speakers (with the meeting recorder or with Tess itself), with the header of job title, area and date; save it as interview_NN.txt in the Input folder, with the systems list and the org chart, and click ▶
  4. 4Replace the activity template and the glossary in the knowledge base with your process office's
  5. 5After validating the map with the project lead, connect Google Docs or Notion to receive the map as text; the process diagram comes later, outside the agent
Done when

Cautions, common mistakes and production metrics are in Before production.

Before production

Cautions

The agent describes the process as the interviewees say it happens; it does not propose improvements or write the future process, because mixing what is with what should be invalidates a mapping. Every activity must be traceable to a transcript and every contradiction quotes both statements verbatim. Transcripts contain names and opinions about colleagues: the map cites department and job title, and any excerpt that evaluates a person is left out.

Common mistakes

  • Resolving the contradiction by picking the most plausible version; the divergence is the finding and the validation resolves it.
  • Writing the process as it should be instead of as it is; the interviewee describes the official procedure, and the agent separates that from what they actually do.
  • Accepting stated time as measured time; the field is stated and must be labeled as such.

Metrics

MetricRangeSource
Analyst's time between the last interview and the map ready for validationfrom 3 days to less than 1 dayestimate based on the described routine
Contradictions between departments taken to the validation meetingfrom not recorded to 100% of divergences with a verbatim quoteprocess target, not the agent's (estimate based on the described routine)
Activities from the approved map recovered by the agent85% or more in calibration on the reference processestimate based on the described routine

Sample production output

Fictional sample. Process: employee onboarding. 7 transcripts, 41 activities, 9 handoffs, 3 contradictions, 5 open questions.
01 | Request approved position from HR | Manager | form on the portal | input: budget approval | output: requisition opened | stated time: 1 day
14 | Request creation of access | HR | email to IT | output: ticket opened | stated time: 2 to 5 days (see contradiction 2)
15 | Create user and email | IT | corporate directory | input: ticket with job title and manager
HANDOFF 4: HR to IT (activity 14 to 15), by email, with no agreed deadline, rework reported by 3 interviewees.
CONTRADICTION 2: HR says access is ready in 2 days ("IT releases it in two days", interview 2); IT says 5 business days from a complete ticket ("five days counting from the ticket with all the data", interview 5).
OPEN QUESTION 3: who checks the pre-employment medical exam before the first day? No interviewee said they were responsible.
